title: aifullpeople state
description: Documentation reference for .aifullpeople/state.json — not enforced by a script (architecture.md §5: reading/editing this file is model work via Read/Edit, not script work). Read this before hand-editing the file. state.json is the single source of truth; .aifullpeople/report.md is a rendering of it, never a second source (architecture.md §13).

context_project.description: Pointer to context_project.md at the project root (architecture.md §11) — the file itself lives OUTSIDE .aifullpeople/ because it serves any methodology, not just aifullpeople.

artifacts.description: Project-level artifacts produced by the pm role.

status.description: pending_approval means drafted and saved to disk, awaiting the human checkpoint (architecture.md §15) before the next role may start. Only 'done' unlocks the next role.

id.description: F01, F02, ... Zero-padded, sequential, no gaps. Next ID = read the array, take the highest, add 1 (no script — architecture.md §5).

methodology.description: Locked at feature creation. Immutable afterwards (architecture.md §9) — a feature is only ever closed by the methodology that opened it.

estimated_difficulty.description: Set by tech-lead in tasks.md generation.

real_difficulty.description: Set by evaluator at done, from what the task reports showed (deviations, retries). null until then (architecture.md §13).

tokens_estimated.description: Sum of per-task token estimates for this feature. Set at done. null until then.

fix_cycles.description: Incremented once per aifullpeople-developer-fix-runner run against this feature (architecture.md §19). Distinguishes original tasks.md tasks from post-rejection corrective passes — never folded into the tasks[] list.

id.description: <feature-id>-T<n>. Includes the feature id because tasks live in a flat list, unlike contract.md items which are always read within their own feature's file.

phase.description: The tasks.md phase this task belongs to (Phase 1, 2, 3...), set by tech-lead. This list is flat for lookup, but phase must stay visible here and in every developer task report — otherwise the grouping tech-lead defined disappears the moment developer starts executing (found by a user reading the wordcount example and losing track of which task belonged to which phase).
